The canonical from WPTV already reports the core competency ruling with the same key facts (two doctors, Aug hearing, state mental hospital). The additional background in the incoming article does not constitute a material new update to the competency ruling itself—it's explanatory context that another outlet included in their coverage of the same ruling.
